plan.question: Per-child CPU/allocation/resident memory and post-close reclamation; no optimization
plan.creation: sequential, same snapshot; not P4 throughput
plan.scope: one local M1; no guest/product/public API changes; no v0.7 resource acceptance
plan.stop: report CPU vs wall, allocation vs live/RSS, retained-child slope, post-close natural/GC/scavenge; do not optimize or expand matrix
